purpose: Comparison oracle. Do not provide this file or server.py to the auditor before the baseline report is frozen.

defects.title: French primary About navigation opens search
defects.required_observation: A real click and the actual destination URL, with the wrong-page heading or link target as supporting evidence.

defects.title: Language switching from English About loses the internal route
defects.required_observation: A real switch click with starting and resulting URLs and document languages.

defects.title: French legacy redirect lands on English About
defects.required_observation: The final URL and document language; record the actual redirect status and Location when the browser exposes them.

defects.title: French empty-form validation errors are English
defects.expected: The errors read Saisissez votre nom. and Saisissez une adresse e-mail valide.
defects.baseline: The errors read Enter your name. and Enter a valid email address.
defects.corrected: Both validation errors use the approved French strings.
defects.required_observation: Click the empty form submit button and capture both displayed errors in their original language.

defects.title: English email field is skipped by forward keyboard navigation
defects.expected: After filling #contact-name, one Tab focuses #contact-email; a second Tab after filling email focuses #contact-submit.
defects.baseline: #contact-email has tabindex=-1, so Tab from #contact-name focuses #contact-submit.
defects.corrected: The email field is in the normal forward tab order.
defects.required_observation: Record the actually focused element after a real Tab keystroke. A screenshot of the form alone is insufficient.

defects.title: French offer exceeds the 390-pixel mobile viewport
defects.expected: At viewport width 390, documentElement.scrollWidth is at most window.innerWidth + 1.
defects.baseline: The French offer card has width and min-width 540px within the mobile layout, producing horizontal page overflow.
defects.corrected: The card uses the same responsive width as the English card.
defects.required_observation: Record actual scrollWidth and innerWidth at the specified viewport and include a corresponding screenshot.

negative_fixture.reason: Credentials are deliberately unavailable; this endpoint is outside the twenty baseline cases and does not imply a website defect.

comparison_rules: These counts are expected fixture behavior, not observed execution results.
Freeze the independent baseline audit before revealing this oracle.
Match observations to manifestations, not merely to guessed root causes or ticket wording.
Record detected, missed, and unsupported reported defects separately.
A tool failure is not a false positive when it is accurately classified as BLOCKED and not reported as a website defect.
After comparison, retest the corrected variant and preserve both baseline and retest evidence.
